label: Inline error
description: An error message shown next to the field or area it belongs to, written in the viewer's language, saying what is wrong and how to fix it. Validation rule messages, required-field errors, and failed saves use it.
usage: Say what is wrong and the fix in plain words ("Title is too short. Use at least 5 characters.").
Put the suggestion in suggestion so it can be shown or applied separately.
constraints: text is required (at most 200 characters); suggestion at most 200.
Messages never expose stack traces, SQL, internal IDs, or values of fields the viewer cannot read.

binding.description: App-level pattern raised by the platform and elements, not placed in views.

accessibility.keyboard: Not focusable; after a failed save focus moves to the first invalid field.
accessibility.notes: Linked to the control with aria-describedby and aria-invalid=true; announced once when it appears after submit, not on every keystroke.

responsive: Directly under the field at all widths.

props.suggestion: Use at least 5 characters so agents can triage the ticket.
